text: Why does classful addressing still matter in 2026, thirty-three years after its abolition?
choices: It shapes equipment defaults, some routing protocol auto-summarisation, the way RFC 1918 ranges are described, and the language engineers still speak
explanation: Type an address into many devices and they suggest a mask based on its class; accept it without thinking and you have a /8 where you wanted a /24. Know it well enough to recognise it when a device does something surprising, and never reason from it.
